cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(urbix VERSION 0.7.1 LANGUAGES C)

include(GNUInstallDirs)
include(CMakePackageConfigHelpers)

# Option to build from Rust sources vs using prebuilt lib.
option(URBIX_BUILD_FROM_SOURCE "Build liburbix via cargo" ON)

if(URBIX_BUILD_FROM_SOURCE)
    find_program(CARGO cargo REQUIRED)
    # Build the Rust crate (staticlib + cdylib). Header is generated by build.rs.
    add_custom_target(cargo_build ALL
        COMMAND ${CARGO} build --release
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
        COMMENT "Building liburbix via cargo"
        VERBATIM
    )
    # Import the produced libraries as imported targets for install.
    # They will exist after cargo_build runs.
    set(URBIX_STATIC_LIB ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/target/release/liburbix.a)
    set(URBIX_SHARED_LIB ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/target/release/liburbix${CMAKE_SHARED_LIBRARY_SUFFIX})
    # Fallbacks for Windows names.
    if(WIN32)
        set(URBIX_STATIC_LIB ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/target/release/urbix.lib)
        set(URBIX_SHARED_LIB ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/target/release/urbix${CMAKE_SHARED_LIBRARY_SUFFIX})
    endif()
endif()

# Header is always installed.
install(FILES include/urbix.h DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})

# Install prebuilt or cargo-built libs if present.
install(FILES ${URBIX_STATIC_LIB} DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR} OPTIONAL)
install(FILES ${URBIX_SHARED_LIB} DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR} OPTIONAL)

# pkg-config
configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/urbix.pc.in
               ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/urbix.pc @ONLY)
install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/urbix.pc
        DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/pkgconfig)

# CMake package config
write_basic_package_version_file(
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/urbixConfigVersion.cmake"
    VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION}
    COMPATIBILITY SameMajorVersion
)
configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/urbixConfig.cmake.in
               ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/urbixConfig.cmake @ONLY)
install(FILES
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/urbixConfig.cmake
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/urbixConfigVersion.cmake
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/urbix
)
